answer: Eighty phantom sky-posts were collecting comet-alert bounties from a single laptop until the registry changed the rule. Observer 9 must now stand at peg G-4 in the mapped pine grove, ignite a 1.8 kg kerosene flare, and keep a 14-minute 4.2-micron exhaust plume in view of two IR cameras 2.1 km apart. The observer posts a 9-unit bond first. If either camera records no plume, or the flare GPS sits more than 18 m off the peg, the bond burns and that post is barred for 6 epochs.
